name: Stirling PDF
description: PDF tools in the browser: merge, split, convert, compress, sign and OCR, processed on this server and kept nowhere.

access.note: Stirling PDF 2.x has its login switched on, so the first thing you see is a sign-in form rather than the tools page. Use the sign-in name you entered here and the generated password shown beside it; it may ask you to choose a new password straight away. Both values only seed the account on the very first start with an empty settings volume — after that the account lives in the app's own database.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Optional; the address other people open; nothing else here changes when it does.

inputs.name: admin-username
inputs.label: Sign-in name
inputs.description: The first administrator's sign-in name. Seeded on the first start only; afterwards you change it inside the application.

secrets.name: admin-password
secrets.label: Sign-in password
secrets.description: Generated here. Without it the image starts with its own published default password.
